text:
**Depot:** Fenbury
**Context:**
- Lifts near garden studio, north office, print room, library annex, and harbour room are slow.
- Garden studio, north office, print room, loading bay (afternoon), and harbour room (morning) are being repainted; expect noise. North office also has evening noise.
- Stand-ups: Morning (harbour room), Afternoon (east wing), Evening (loading bay).
- Out: Mira, Opal, Rafe, Wren, Vik, Una, Jonah, Bram, Kira.
- Coverage: Pia (Mira/Opal), Dell (Jonah/Nils/Vik), Greta (Wren), Hugo (Bram), Finn (Kira). Vik covers Jonah. Ada covers Rafe.
- Visitor requests: Opal, Hugo, Ines, Vik, Una, Suri, Ada want print room, harbour room, garden studio, library annex clear. Una also wants loading bay clear. Leon wants harbour room clear. Ada wants library annex clear. Greta wants north office clear. Suri wants harbour room kept clear.
- Preferences: Wren (east wing), Kira (print room), Una (north office). Jonah prefers library annex for reviews. Rafe prefers loading bay for reviews.
- Desk swaps: Greta/Mira, Opal/Hugo, Opal/Suri, Cora/Nils, Leon/Rafe, Ines/Bram, Greta/Ines, Ines/Jonah.
- Umbrellas: Garden studio, north office, library annex, print room, harbour room, loading bay.
- Cold spots: Wren (loading bay morning), Esme (loading bay evening), Ada (north office evening), Leon (east wing afternoon), Bram (north office morning, harbour room afternoon). Pia thinks print room is too cold in the morning.
- Coffee machines: Garden studio, harbour room, east wing, north office, library annex, print room working.
- Notes to send: Mira, Jonah, Pia, Kira, Bram (evening meeting notes). Still need to send Jonah morning meeting notes.
- Queries: Greta (harbour room evening), Cora (library annex afternoon), Mira (garden studio evening), Dell (print room afternoon availability). Finn asked if loading bay is free in the morning.
- Action items: Check with Pia, Esme, Jonah, Vik. Check with Nils before morning meeting. Check with Greta before morning meeting. Check with Leon before afternoon meeting.

**Order:**
- 165 ladders.
- 265 toolkits.
- Flat delivery fee: 45.
